subject: POC launch readiness & calendar sync — availability + owners
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: James Tang <james.tang@orchidpay.com>, ops-eng@orchidpay.com
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC launch readiness & calendar sync — availability + owners

Hi James / Orchid Pay team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to get the POC started. To make the kickoff efficient, we'd like to align on a 90-minute POC kickoff that covers success criteria, network prerequisites, timeline, and owners. Proposed attendees:
- James Tang (Customer eng lead)
- ops-eng@orchidpay.com (infrastructure)
- procurement@orchidpay.com (contracts, if available)
- security@orchidpay.com (brief on data & access)
- Neha Kapoor (AE)
- Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer)
- Ava Chen (SE, infra lead)
- Soojin Lee (Principal SE) — will jump in if deep infra questions surface

Windows we have next week (all Pacific):
- Tue 2026-06-16, 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed 2026-06-17, 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30

Success criteria (draft):
- Dev environment up with sample data accessible to Redwood runtime
- End-to-end inference flow: sample request -> model response within target latency
- Access controls validated (network CIDR, IP allowlist or VPN)
- Measurement plan in place for cost/latency during the POC

I've attached a short success criteria doc and a network checklist we typically use. Can you confirm attendees and the best window? If procurement needs to be on a separate call, flag that and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
From: James Tang <james.tang@orchidpay.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-eng@orchidpay.com, procurement@orchidpay.com, security@orchidpay.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:40:12 -0400
Subject: Re: POC launch readiness & calendar sync — availability + owners

Thanks Neha — appreciate the clear plan. Quick notes:
- Can we move the kickoff out a week? Our infra lead is on a cross-region migration next week and won't be available.
- I added procurement and security on CC — procurement will just observe initially but wants to confirm commercial milestones afterwards. Security will want the network checklist before the call.

New preferred window from our side (ET):
- Tue 2026-06-23, 11:00–12:30 ET (that maps to 08:00–09:30 PT)
- Thu 2026-06-25, 14:00–15:30 ET

Also: are there any firewall/IP allowlist entries or VPN creds you need ahead of the call? If so, send the specifics and our network team will try to pre-provision.

—James
James Tang | Director, Platform Engineering, Orchid Pay
james.tang@orchidpay.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: James Tang <james.tang@orchidpay.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, ops-eng@orchidpay.com, security@orchidpay.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC launch readiness & calendar sync — availability + owners

Hi James — thanks for the heads up. A few technical clarifications to help your network team pre-provision:
- IPs/ports we use: 34.208.12.0/24 (outbound), TCP 443; we can provide a named DNS endpoint if you'd prefer FQDNs.
- If you require VPN-based access, we'll need a temporary service account and hostnames for the app endpoints.
- For the POC we recommend sample dataset S3 access with read-only credentials scoped to a single bucket/prefix.

I've attached Network-Reqs.xlsx with these specifics and a lightweight runbook. Also attached a one-page POC success criteria doc (POC-Success-Criteria-v1.pdf) that maps each criteria to owner (AE/SE/customer).

Availability: I can cover either of the June 23 or June 25 windows mentioned. If procurement only needs to observe, we can keep the kickoff to 75–90 minutes and follow up with a procurement stub call for contracts.

—Soojin
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: James Tang <james.tang@orchidpay.com>, ops-eng@orchidpay.com, procurement@orchidpay.com, security@orchidpay.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:02:45 -0700
Subject: Re: POC launch readiness & calendar sync — availability + owners

Thanks all — June 23 works for our team. Proposed calendar invite below (I'll send the official invite after confirmation):
- Kickoff: Tue, 23 Jun 2026, 08:00–09:30 PT / 11:00–12:30 ET
- Location: Google Meet (link will be in invite)

Agenda (75–90 min):
1) Introductions & scope (5–10m) — Neha
2) Success criteria walkthrough + owners (10–15m) — Soojin (see attached PDF)
3) Network & access checklist (15–20m) — Ava / ops-eng
4) POC timeline & measurement plan (15m) — Dev
5) Risk / procurement notes & next steps (10m) — Neha / procurement

Owners:
- AE / commercial: Neha Kapoor (onboarding, commercial questions)
- SE / infra lead: Ava Chen (network, infra validation)
- SE / runtime & tests: Dev Patel (measurement plan, demo scripts)
- Principal SE: Soojin Lee (technical authority for deviations)

Action items before the kickoff (owners in parentheses):
- Customer: confirm list of attendees + any calendar conflicts (James)
- Customer network: try to pre-provision IP allowlist or provide VPN details (ops-eng@orchidpay.com)
- Redwood: final invite + meeting link (Neha)
- Redwood: upload runbook + test scripts to Drive link shared earlier (Dev / Soojin)

If procurement wants a separate 30-min session to review licensing milestones after the POC, suggest Tue 2026-06-30 — procurement, let us know if that works.

Neha
From: James Tang <james.tang@orchidpay.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, ops-eng@orchidpay.com, procurement@orchidpay.com
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC launch readiness & calendar sync — availability + owners

Neha, all — confirmed. June 23 at 11:00 ET works for Orchid Pay. I've asked procurement to be on the initial call in observer mode; they will follow up re: SOW/PO cadence. Security will review the Network-Reqs.pdf and get back with any questions by Monday 6/21.

One ask: can Redwood provide a short checklist (1 page) that procurement can use to mark POC acceptance criteria tied to billing/trial credits? That will speed approvals on our end.

Thanks — James
